description: This file defines a Flutter widget named AuthScaffold, which provides a styled, gradient-background scaffold with a centered auth card. It is used as a reusable layout component for authentication screens like Login and Signup.

classes.name: AuthScaffold
classes.description: A stateless widget that creates a styled authentication scaffold with a gradient background, centered content, and optional footer.

methods.name: AuthScaffold
methods.description: Constructor for the AuthScaffold widget, accepting title, child, and optional footer components.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the AuthScaffold, composing containers, scaffold, safe area, centered constrained box, and styled content including title, child, and footer.
